description: This class includes the manufacture of fresh, frozen or dry bakery products. It includes bread, rolls, biscuits, pies, cakes, pastries, waffles, pancakes and other similar baked goods.
includes: manufacture of fresh bread and rolls
manufacture of fresh pastry goods and cakes
manufacture of rusks, biscuits and other dry bakery products
manufacture of pies, tarts, pasties and similar
manufacture of snack products: pretzels, popcorn, etc.
excludes: manufacture of farinaceous products (pasta, macaroni), see 1074
retail sale of bakery products, see 4721
